featured_reviews.name: Jitendra Meshram
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very bad experience with Heena Digital Photo Studio, which is why I’m giving them a 1-star rating.

I had ordered two 20x30 cm family photos with frames from Heena Photo Studio, Chembur. One of the frames had a small gap on the top side that needed minor repair. When I pointed it out, their response was, “We won’t repair it; if you want, you can take a full refund.”

I repeatedly requested them to fix it, but they refused, saying that after repair I might again find some fault and that this would go on forever. Such a negative and unprofessional attitude is disappointing.

I had also given them another photo order, but they refused to take that as well. I have never had such a poor experience before. They completely lack professionalism and do not know how to take customer feedback positively.

Despite my repeated requests, they kept saying, “We’ll refund your money, please get the work done from another studio.”
Is this how you treat a customer? They are literally avoiding customers instead of resolving the issue.

I was ready to give them more business with two big frames, but they refused to work. Totally hopeless service.

featured_reviews.name: jpdumini un
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the most disappointing and unprofessional experiences we have had.

We hired this photographer for an indoor photoshoot during a very personal and important phase of our lives. Unfortunately, the experience did not meet reasonable expectations of transparency and professionalism.

From the initial interaction, he appeared polite and reassuring, including using greetings such as “Om Sai Ram”. However, this did not translate into clear communication around pricing or deliverables.

He was booked to click only a few photos, but significantly more photos were taken without clearly disclosing the applicable charges in advance. After the shoot, absurdly higher amount than expected was quoted for sharing the remaining photos. Had the pricing structure been clearly communicated beforehand, we would have limited the scope or opted for a different package.

Post-shoot discussions focused largely on payment, with limited clarity or flexibility. Similar concerns are reflected in other Google reviews for this studio (Sadhna Photography).

Based on our experience, we would advise others to exercise caution and ensure complete clarity on pricing and deliverables before booking, especially for important occasions.
